xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnComposition:
The composition of the Board of the Bank is constituted in terms of the provisions of the Banking Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertakings) Act 1970. All the Directors on the Board of the Bank except Shareholder Director are nominated/appointed by Department of Financial Services, MOF, GOI. Since the public shareholding of the Bank is less than 16%, bank is permitted to elect only one director from amongst the shareholders other than Central Government.
Ms. Rachna Khare has tendered her resignation on 25-12-2025 which was intimated to exchange on 26-12-2025.
